description: The pending-type contract of Phase 2 (spec §B.1, §D.7): which TypeScript files and type names mirror the build-out schema, and the objects each must declare. scripts/db/check-pending-contract.mjs reads this map with a TypeScript Program + TypeChecker ('@/' -> src/) and compares it with the harness export of scripts/db/schema-export.mjs. Lane 1 owns this file; the TS files belong to Lane 2 and are never edited by the checker. While two streams build at once, each keeps its entries in scripts/db/contract-map.d/<stream>.json (merged by the checker) and the integrator folds them in here at the wave merge (Phase 3 wave 1: folded on 27 Nov 2026).

files.mirrors: X1 spec §6 060100 (X1-01: reference data, positions, position manning), 060200 (X1-02: vessel crew list, movements, transfers table), 060300 (X1-03: personal details, languages, employment terms, next-of-kin phone columns, profile RPCs), 060400 (X1-04: document catalogue, vessel crew settings, crew document columns, document RPCs), 060500 (X1-05: document versions, review rights, verify, alerts off and on, renew), 060600 (X1-06: requirement rows, options and positions, the compliance views, the compliance and configuration RPCs) and 061100 (X1-11: the probation and notice columns of crew_contracts; the transfer RPCs: options, start, review, acknowledge, submit, decide, cancel, the one completion definer transfer_crew, one transfer and a person's transfers; the employment RPCs: end employment, the vessel's employment history and the re-hire prefill)
